pairs.subject: multi-provider-event-normalization
pairs.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_mastermind/lib/llmSpend.ts:6 This context gets LLM spend that has already been normalized: it imports fetchLlmPinpoints from the sub_llm_overview adapter context and only sums totalCostUsd per project (llmSpend.ts:25). It has no ingestion door, span mapper, provider matcher, usage extractor or event-id rule. A grep of src/features/teams/sub_mastermind for gen_ai, spanId, span_id, otlp, prompt_tokens and completion_tokens found nothing, so the subject's precondition (ingesting or mapping telemetry it did not emit) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_mastermind/lib/llmSpend.ts:24 It calls the adapter's single fetch function and adds no door or pipeline stage of its own.
